content: {"phoneNote":"Hero photo and headline work well, but the two hero actions are plain text links stacked under a long headline, so the fixed bar becomes the only visible call to action on the first screen.","desktopNote":"The overlapping dark hero card is a nice move, but it pushes its own links below the fold and leaves a dead light band to its right and beneath the photo.","phone":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":3},"desktop":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":4},"fixes":["Give the hero one real primary button (Rezervirajte / Pokličite) and demote the second to a text link; on desktop shorten the card so both actions sit above the fold.","Fill the empty right half of the accommodation section: put the apartment card beside the room card at equal height, or add a second room photo so the strip isn't half blank.","Remove the repeated 'Navodila za pot' / 'Pišite nam' links: they appear in hero, Obiščite nas and the Rezervirajte block; keep contact actions in one place plus footer."],"blockers":["Desktop hero: the dark card overhangs the photo and leaves an unbalanced empty band to its right and under the image before the contact section."]}
